Select the node to read its description and change the amount, then save and playtest.
<b>地图决定场地，规则决定玩法。</b>\n\n基础页：关卡名、编号、地图、初: The map sets the field; the rules set the gameplay. Basic page: level name, ID, map, starting Sun and total waves. Mode page: disable normal zombie spawns, natural Sun, lawn mowers, plus special modes such as Conveyor Belt, It's Raining Seeds and I, Zombie. Win page: choose the normal win or the I, Zombie win. Tips for your first level Adjust only the starting Sun and zombie spawns at first. Playtest after every mode switch you turn on, so you can tell which setting changed the gameplay. "Disable Normal Spawns" stops the usual wave spawns; if it is on, you must set up your own way to spawn enemies. If no enemies appear, check here first. Turning on many modes at once in a first level is not recommended. The editor does not guarantee that every combination works together. Win/Lose nodes Special objectives can use the "Make Game Win/End" node to end the level, but make sure it triggers only when the objective is truly completed or failed. For normal levels, use the built-in win/lose rules first.
<b>卡牌设置</b>\n配置玩家预选卡、卡槽数量，以及需要覆盖的价格和冷却。修: Card Setup Set the player's preselected cards, slot count, and any price and cooldown overrides. After changing card values, submit them with that page's Save Changes button, then save the whole level. Do not treat text you have typed but not yet submitted as saved. Two Spawn Settings "Set Spawns" picks which zombie types random spawns may use. The wave-by-wave page schedules fixed zombies and their rows for specific waves. They serve different purposes. If an unexpected enemy shows up, check three sources: the random pool, the wave list, and event spawns. Timing and Waves First-wave time and wave interval are set on the Mode Settings page. The event "When Level Wave Increases" fires on every wave change; to limit it to wave 5, compare whether the wave equals 5. Coordinates Are Easy to Mix Up The fixed-spawn editor uses player-facing row numbers; event node rows and columns start from 0. In a node, enter 0 for the first row and 1 for the second. Do not copy the row number shown on the page.
<b>预设植物和罐子</b>\n进入布置战场，摆放植物或罐子，退出后布置结果写回: Preset Plants and Pots Enter Arrange Battlefield, place plants or pots, and when you exit, the layout is written back to the current menu draft. You still need to return to the menu to save and generate the level. Preset plants are placed before the event graph starts listening, so "On Plant Planted" will not fire for them. To handle them together, use "Level Start > Get All Plants On Field > Loop Over Plant List". Planting Rules Still Apply Water, roofs, support plants, and occupied tiles all affect whether creation succeeds. "Create Plant" follows the normal rules by default; on failure you can hook up a text message. Force Plant is for setups that deliberately skip some planting checks. Special Settings Page The Gods evolution route and stage settings need the current edit submitted; the Random Stats page sets the variation range. Make sure a normal level works first, then enable these one at a time. Before entering Arrange Battlefield, save any configuration on the current page that must be submitted manually.
<b>一条规则 = 什么时候 → 判断什么 → 做什么</b>\n\n例：“第5: One Rule = When > Check What > Do What Example: "Show a message when wave 5 starts." On Level Wave Increase > Branch > Show Text is the order of execution. Wave > Integer Compare (equals 5) is the data the branch needs for its condition. Two Kinds of Wires Execution signal: from an event's "Trigger" to an action's "Trigger". Without it, the action usually will not run. Data: carries numbers, text, plant objects, and so on. Connecting only data will not make an action start on its own. Drag from an output on the right to an input on the left; the types must match. Integers and decimals need a conversion node. How to Fill In Input Values Select a node, then click "Fill Input Values" above. For example, enter 5 for a wait time or 25 for a sun amount, with no extra constant node needed. A connected input is supplied by its upstream node and cannot also be overridden by hand; the typed value is used only after you disconnect the wire. Common Differences Plant type: e.g. Peashooter, which means "which kind". Plant object: one specific plant on the field, which means "which one". A variable port is a reference to shared storage. When you need a number, connect a read node such as "Get Integer". Event node rows and columns start from 0; wait times are in seconds. Canvas Controls Right-click to create a node; left-click to select; middle-drag on empty space to pan; scroll wheel to zoom; Delete to delete; Ctrl+C/V to copy and paste; Ctrl+Z/Y to undo and redo. Middle-clicking a node removes its wires, so start panning from empty space. Select a node and click "Node Help" to see all its ports and examples.
<b>目标：正式开场后，每5秒获得25阳光。</b>\n\n方法一：事件页 →: Goal: gain 25 sun every 5 seconds once the level officially starts. Method 1: Events page > Add Rule Template > Gain Sun Every 5 Seconds. The system lays out the wires and moves the nodes into view. Method 2: Build it by hand. 1. Right-click to add "Level Officially Starts", "Periodic Toggle", and "Gain Sun". 2. Connect the "Trigger" of Officially Starts to the "Trigger" of Periodic Toggle. 3. Connect the "Periodic Event" of Periodic Toggle to the "Trigger" of Gain Sun. 4. Select Periodic Toggle, click "Fill Input Values", and set "Period Interval" to 5. 5. Select Gain Sun and likewise set the sun amount to 25. 6. Click "Check Wires", then save and generate the level, and enter the game. What You Should See The timer starts after the preparation, placement, and plant phases end; the first sun comes after 5 seconds, then every 5 seconds. The timer also pauses when the game is paused. If It Does Not Work Nothing happens: check that the execution signal is connected and that the game is not still paused. Only runs once: did you connect "On Enable" instead of "Periodic Event"? Stops suddenly: triggering the same periodic node again turns it off; switching to a new mode's gameplay phase also stops the previous phase's periodic effects.
<b>上方这一栏是“事件规则工具”。</b>\n它帮助你搭建、修改和检查规则，本: The bar above is the "Event Rule Tools". It helps you build, edit, and check rules; it does not add any effect to the level by itself. Most Common Actions Add Rule Template: drops a ready-wired rule onto the canvas for you to modify as needed. Node Help: select a node to see what it does, what each port connects to, and connection examples. Fill Input Values: directly enter unconnected inputs such as wait seconds or sun amount. Check Wires: finds missing nodes, type mismatches, loops, and other problems. Still playtest even if it passes. Undo/Redo: restores recent node edits; up to 40 edit records are kept. More Tools View Whole Graph: brings back nodes dragged off screen. View Execution Log: turn logging on first, playtest, then come back to see which nodes were run. Save/Restore Node Draft: saves only this event graph; it does not replace saving the whole level. Legacy Level Compatibility: decides whether, after a wait, the data from trigger time or the latest data is used. Existing old levels should keep their original setting. Two Panels on the Left The "Node Details" and "Level Variables" buttons show or hide their panels separately; hiding does not lose content. Node Details: shows the purpose of the selected node; scroll to read long descriptions. Enter a node ID at the bottom and press Enter to locate it. Level Variables: create variables with "+ Integer / + Decimal / + Boolean / + String / + List", click a list item, then edit its name and initial value in Node Details; drag a list item onto the canvas to create a variable reference. Decimal means floating point; Boolean means true or false. Dragging in the same variable many times still shares one value. Deleting a variable also deletes its reference nodes; with a group selected, the details area lets you rename the group. Recommended Order Add template > select a node and read its help > fill in values > check wires > save the whole level at the bottom > playtest.
<b>三种保存不是同一件事</b>\n页面里的保存修改：提交该页卡牌或路线等局部: The Three Saves Are Not the Same Save Changes on a page: submits that page's local edits, such as cards or routes. Save Node Draft: backs up the event graph so node edits can be restored. "Save and Generate Level" at the bottom: exports the complete level, including the event graph and all submitted page settings. Check While Playtesting Can you pick cards, plant, and spawn zombies normally? Do the waves advance? Do victory and defeat trigger? Do events fire at the expected time? Is a one-time reward given twice? Is a plant that dies while waiting still handled correctly? Exit and re-enter once to confirm counts, tasks, and rewards have no leftovers from the previous run. Rule Does Not Run First click Check Wires, and confirm both data wires and execution wires are connected. Open More Tools > View Execution Log > turn on logging, then playtest. If the log shows the event but no action, check the branch condition. If it shows no event at all, check the trigger condition; for example, preset plants do not fire a planting event. If the wave-clear reward does not appear, confirm this mode uses normal wave spawning; special spawn modes may not emit the completion event that wave-clear needs. File Protection A level file that loads abnormally is kept, and saving over it leaves a backup of the previous version. Do not delete the original file to deal with a node problem you do not understand.
<b>玩家现在能做的事</b>\n\n1. 直接插入“第5波提示”“每5秒阳光”: What Players Can Do Now 1. Insert the "Wave 5 Message", "Sun Every 5 Seconds", and "Pick 1 of 3 After Clear" templates directly, saving you from rebuilding repeated nodes. 2. Use Phase nodes to organize combat, rewards, and other stages; use "Run Once" to avoid giving rewards twice. 3. Give a name to a target on the field, such as "Boss", then find it elsewhere; you can also listen for fusions and boss HP thresholds, or query the plant layer on a tile. 4. Use the new reward-choice node to connect the pick-one-of-three menu, reducing mistakes where the option list is wired to ordinary items. 5. Undo edits, fill input values, check wires, view the execution log, and save node drafts. Fixes to Existing Problems Fixed rewiring that still read the old connection, incomplete deletion after copying a variable, errors when some multiplier inputs were unconnected, and old waits and callbacks lingering after leaving a level. How Old Levels Are Handled Old nodes and wires are kept, and the original value-reading behavior is unchanged by default. New rules can keep the data from each event trigger, so two clicks do not overwrite each other. UI Additions This Time The right-click menu is on top; common actions and more tools are separated; the creator guide can be opened from any settings page; Node Help now includes ports, connection examples, and notes. These are all tools: you must add and connect the matching rules for them to have any effect in the level.
关卡变量新增“+ 字符串”和“+ 列表”。字符串可以读写和转换；列表在节点详情点:
Level Variables now include "+ String" and "+ List". Strings can be read, written, and converted; for lists, click Edit Initial Value in Node Details. They support integers, decimals, Booleans, strings, plant types, zombie types, and objects. Each page holds 8 items, up to 512 items, and indexes start from 0.

Choose the append, insert, replace, get, and find nodes that match the list's type. Find outputs both the first index and whether it is contained; -1 means not found. After a delete, the later elements shift forward; copying creates independent elements, so later edits do not affect the original list.

Object binding gives an object on the field a queryable name. String object tokens are valid only for the current run and are not written to the save. Create Event Object is a visual marker and does not occupy a plant tile; Destroy Object can only destroy markers created by this graph. Plants and zombies are still created or removed through their own nodes.
新增战斗规则的使用边界: Limits of the New Combat Rules
模式设置新增“僵尸进家失败”，默认开启，旧关卡保持原规则。关闭后可用事件自行判定:
Mode Settings now has "Zombies Reaching House Fails", on by default; old levels keep the original rule. When off, you can use events to decide victory or defeat yourself; other loss sources such as a protected target still apply.

Advanced Card Mode > Full Stats: edit HP, damage, interval, armor, and more. These apply only to the current level, and you still must save the whole level.

Zombie spawn and movement now have "Column (Decimal)"; for example 2.5 is between columns 3 and 4. If left blank, the old integer port is used.

The wait-for-condition and loop-until-condition nodes recheck on a timer, 0.1 seconds by default; the loop is not a same-frame infinite loop, and it is cancelled automatically when you switch phases or leave the level.

Map Switch only supports swapping a day/night map pair with the same terrain; it does not rebuild occupied tiles or change game speed. Different terrain takes the failure output with a reason.

Bullets are created through the game's object pool. Modify nodes use a dedicated bullet reference, and once a bullet is recycled the old reference is invalid; do not treat a recycled reference as the next bullet. At most 128 event objects or bullets can be created per frame, with at most 256 event objects and 1024 event bullets in total.

Removing an Odyssey Modifier cancels its eligibility and later dynamic effects; one-time resources already claimed and permanent value changes are not rolled back.
棋盘准备好时执行初始化规则。: Runs initialization rules when the board is ready.
把触发出口连到初始化动作；预设植物此时已放置。: Connect the trigger output to initialization actions; preset plants are already placed at this point.
关卡开始 → 显示文本，填写欢迎说明。: Level Start > Show Text, with a welcome message filled in.
它早于正式开场。只想从正式战斗开始计时，用“关卡正式开始”。: It fires before the official start. To start timing only from the real battle, use "Level Officially Starts".
正式开场后开始执行规则。: Starts running rules after the official start.
把触发口连到周期、提示或初始奖励。: Connect the trigger port to a period, a message, or an initial reward.
关卡正式开始 → 周期切换 → 获得阳光。: Level Officially Starts > Periodic Toggle > Gain Sun.
跳过开场也会触发。周期首次动作在一个间隔之后。: Also fires if the intro is skipped. A period's first action comes after one interval.
每次波次增加时执行规则，并提供当前波数。: Runs rules each time the wave increases, and provides the current wave number.
触发口接动作或分支，波次数据接整数比较。: Connect the trigger port to an action or branch, and the wave data to an integer compare.
波次接整数比较的值A，值B填5；等于接分支条件，分支真接显示文本。: Wave goes to Integer Compare value A, value B is 5; Equals goes to the branch condition, and branch True goes to Show Text.
每一波都会触发，不自带“只在第几波”的过滤。: Fires on every wave; it has no built-in "only on wave N" filter.
读取玩家点击的格子、手上物品和左右键。: Reads the tile the player clicked, the item in hand, and left or right button.
执行口启动规则，行列口传入创建或查询节点。: The execution port starts the rule; the row and column ports feed create or query nodes.
点击 → 分支；“是左键”接条件，真出口显示提示。: Click > Branch; "Is Left Click" goes to the condition, and the True output shows a message.
左右键都可能触发。行列从0开始；旧关卡等待后读取最近的点击。: Both left and right clicks can trigger it. Rows and columns start from 0; in old levels, after a wait the most recent click is read.
按指定按键时执行规则。: Runs rules when the specified key is pressed.
在节点中先录入一个按键，再连接触发出口。: Record a key in the node first, then connect the trigger output.
选择一个按键 → 显示文本，用于关卡内交互提示。: Pick a key > Show Text, for in-level interaction prompts.
未录入按键时不会触发。不要与已有游戏快捷键冲突。: It does not trigger if no key is recorded. Do not conflict with existing game hotkeys.
植物种下时执行规则，并提供对应植物。: Runs rules when a plant is planted, and provides that plant.
触发口启动动作，植物口用于读取目标属性或处理该目标。: The trigger port starts the action; the plant port is used to read the target's properties or handle that target.
事件触发 → 获得阳光，数量填25；需要限制种类时先接植物属性拆分和类型比较。: Event Trigger > Gain Sun, amount 25; to limit by type, first connect Split Plant Properties and a type compare.
不会补发开局已有的预设植物。: Does not fire for preset plants already present at the start.
玩家点击植物时执行规则，并提供对应植物。: Runs rules when the player clicks a plant, and provides that plant.
与点击空格子的鼠标事件不同。: Different from the mouse event for clicking an empty tile.
植物血量归零时执行规则，并提供对应植物。: Runs rules when a plant's HP reaches zero, and provides that plant.
不覆盖融合、主动移除等所有死亡原因。: Does not cover every cause of death, such as fusion or manual removal.
植物完成死亡处理时执行规则，并提供对应植物。: Runs rules when a plant finishes its death handling, and provides that plant.
对象随后可能销毁；等待后要判断目标是否还存在。死亡原因输出是整数。: The object may be destroyed afterward; after a wait, check whether the target still exists. The death cause output is an integer.
植物融合完成时执行规则，并提供对应植物。: Runs rules when a plant fusion completes, and provides that plant.
只监听融合事件，普通种植不会触发。: Listens only for fusion events; ordinary planting does not trigger it.
僵尸生成时执行规则，并提供对应僵尸。: Runs rules when a zombie spawns, and provides that zombie.
触发口接行为，僵尸口接属性拆分或目标处理。: Connect the trigger port to a behavior, and the zombie port to Split Zombie Properties or target handling.
事件 → 显示文本；僵尸属性拆分 → 类型比较 → 分支，可限定特定种类。: Event > Show Text; Split Zombie Properties > Type Compare > Branch, to limit to a specific type.
普通生成和魅惑生成都可能触发，必要时进一步筛选目标。: Normal spawns and charmed spawns may both trigger it; filter the target further if needed.
僵尸死亡时执行规则，并提供对应僵尸。: Runs rules when a zombie dies, and provides that zombie.
目标随后可能销毁，等待后的处理不能假定对象仍存活。: The target may be destroyed afterward, so handling after a wait must not assume the object is still alive.
某波正常出怪完成后，该波的敌人清空时执行一次规则。: After a wave's normal spawning finishes, runs the rule once when that wave's enemies are cleared.
各波分别记录；触发口接奖励或进入下一阶段，波次口输出刚清空的那一波。: Each wave is tracked separately; connect the trigger port to a reward or the next phase, and the wave port outputs the wave that was just cleared.
第2波开始后才清完第1波敌人，仍会输出波次1；第2波敌人无需一起清空。: If wave 1's enemies are only cleared after wave 2 has started, it still outputs wave 1; wave 2's enemies need not be cleared too.
生成或召唤的敌人按当时波次归属，死亡、离场或魅惑后不再阻挡；每波最多一次。依赖正: Spawned or summoned enemies belong to the wave they appeared in; once they die, leave, or are charmed they no longer block it. At most once per wave. It relies on the normal spawn-complete notice, so special spawn modes may not trigger it; the final victory check may also end the battle first.
指定僵尸的本体血量达到阈值时触发。: Triggers when a specified zombie's body HP reaches a threshold.
僵尸口连接首领对象；血量比例填0.5表示半血。: Connect the zombie port to the boss object; set the HP ratio to 0.5 for half HP.
创建首领 → 命名僵尸；获取命名僵尸 → 血量阈值事件 → 切换阶段。: Create Boss > Name Zombie; Get Named Zombie > HP Threshold Event > Switch Phase.
不计算护甲。连续监视同一目标只触发一次，换目标重新检测；已死亡目标不触发。: Armor is not counted. Continuously watching the same target triggers only once; switching targets re-detects; dead targets do not trigger.
进入指定名称的玩法阶段时启动规则。: Starts rules when the gameplay phase with the specified name is entered.
在节点填写阶段名称，与切换阶段使用同一名称。: Fill in the phase name in the node, using the same name as Switch Phase.
切换阶段填“奖励”；进入阶段填“奖励” → 显示奖励选择。: Switch Phase set to "Reward"; Enter Phase set to "Reward" > Show Reward Choice.
阶段初始为空；相同阶段连续切换不会重复触发，名称必须一致。: The phase starts empty; switching to the same phase repeatedly does not retrigger it, and names must match exactly.
把本局事件图切换到指定玩法阶段。: Switches this run's event graph to the specified gameplay phase.
连接触发输入，填写阶段名称；完成口可继续后续动作。: Connect the trigger input and fill in the phase name; the done port can continue to later actions.
首领半血 → 切换阶段，名称填“第二阶段”。: Boss Half HP > Switch Phase, with the name set to "Phase Two".
新方式会停止上一阶段的等待和周期；阶段名称不会自动改变出怪或暂停游戏。: The new way stops the previous phase's waits and periods; a phase name does not automatically change spawns or pause the game.
读取当前玩法阶段的名称。: Reads the name of the current gameplay phase.
把文本输出接到需要阶段名称的文本输入。: Connect the text output to a text input that needs the phase name.
获取当前阶段 → 显示文本的文本口；用按键事件触发显示。: Get Current Phase > text port of Show Text; trigger the display with a key event.
这是数据查询，没有触发口；不会自行切换阶段。: This is a data query with no trigger port; it does not switch phases by itself.
让某条奖励或动作只在第一次收到信号时执行。: Makes a reward or action run only the first time a signal arrives.
首次触发出口接一次性动作；需要重新允许时触发它并将重置设为true。: Connect the first-trigger output to a one-time action; to allow it again, trigger it with Reset set to true.
重复发生的事件 → 只执行一次 → 获得阳光。: Repeating Event > Run Once > Gain Sun.
重置为true的这次调用只清理状态，不执行首次动作；之后需再次触发。: The call with Reset set to true only clears state and does not run the first-time action; you must trigger it again afterward.
给场上一株植物起名字，方便别处找到它。: Gives a name to a plant on the field so it can be found elsewhere.
输入具体植物对象，填写名称，并连接触发信号。: Input a specific plant object, fill in the name, and connect the trigger signal.
创建植物成功 → 命名植物，名称填“目标”；对象输出也连到命名节点。: Create Plant Succeeds > Name Plant, with the name set to "Target"; also connect the object output to the naming node.
同名再次绑定会替换旧目标，仅在当前局事件图中有效。: Binding the same name again replaces the old target, and it is valid only in the current run's event graph.
按名字找到之前绑定的植物。: Finds a plant bound earlier by name.
填写与命名节点完全相同的名称，使用对象与存在输出。: Enter exactly the same name as the naming node, and use the object and exists outputs.
获取命名植物的“存在” → 分支条件；真分支再操作它的对象输出。: Gets whether a named plant "exists" -> Branch condition; then use its object output on the True branch.
找不到或对象已销毁时为空；先检查存在，不要只检查名字。: Empty if not found or the object was destroyed; check existence, not just the name.
给场上一个僵尸起名字，方便别处找到它。: Gives a zombie on the field a name so it can be found elsewhere.
输入具体僵尸对象，填写名称，并连接触发信号。: Input a specific zombie object, fill in the name, and connect the trigger signal.
创建僵尸成功 → 命名僵尸，名称填“目标”；对象输出也连到命名节点。: Zombie created successfully -> Name Zombie, name set to "target"; also connect the object output to the naming node.
按名字找到之前绑定的僵尸。: Finds a previously named zombie by name.
获取命名僵尸的“存在” → 分支条件；真分支再操作它的对象输出。: Gets whether a named zombie "exists" -> Branch condition; then use its object output on the True branch.
在指定格子创建一种植物。: Creates one plant at the given tile.
提供植物种类和行列，连接触发；成功输出接后续处理。: Provide the plant type and row/column, and connect the trigger; connect the success output to what happens next.
正式开始 → 创建植物；行0、列0、豌豆射手；失败口接显示文本。: Game Start -> Create Plant; row 0, column 0, Peashooter; connect the failure output to Show Text.
默认非强制，水面、屋顶、支撑和占用可能导致失败；行列从0开始。: Not forced by default; water, roof, support and occupied tiles may cause failure; rows and columns start at 0.
在指定位置生成指定种类的僵尸。: Spawns a zombie of the given type at the given position.
设置行列、种类和是否魅惑，触发后使用生成的僵尸对象。: Set row, column, type and whether it is hypnotized; after triggering, use the spawned zombie object.
按键事件 → 创建僵尸；创建成功后将对象交给“命名僵尸”。: Key Event -> Create Zombie; after it is created, pass the object to "Name Zombie".
数据口不会自行生成对象，必须先执行创建动作；留意生成位置。: The data output does not create an object by itself; the create action must run first; mind the spawn position.
把已有植物移动到指定行列。: Moves an existing plant to the given row and column.
连接场上的具体植物对象和目标坐标，再连接触发。: Connect a specific plant object on the field and the target coordinates, then connect the trigger.
创建植物后接移动节点，把目标列改为另一格。: After creating a plant, connect a Move node and change the target column to another tile.
种类不能代替对象；越界、占用或失效对象可能导致失败，需接对应结果分支。: A type cannot replace an object; out-of-bounds, occupied or invalid objects may cause failure, so connect the matching result branch.
把已有僵尸移动到指定行列。: Moves an existing zombie to the given row and column.
连接场上的具体僵尸对象和目标坐标，再连接触发。: Connect a specific zombie object on the field and the target coordinates, then connect the trigger.
创建僵尸后接移动节点，把目标列改为另一格。: After creating a zombie, connect a Move node and change the target column to another tile.
在场上生成可拾取的植物卡牌。: Spawns a pickable plant card on the field.
指定植物种类和生成行列，再连接触发。: Specify the plant type and spawn row/column, then connect the trigger.
僵尸死亡 → 创建植物卡牌，设置要掉落的植物种类。: Zombie Dies -> Create Plant Card, set the plant type to drop.
它创建场上卡牌，不是直接添加到卡槽；后者用“添加植物卡牌”。: It creates a card on the field, not one added directly to the seed slot; use "Add Plant Card" for that.
给玩家卡槽添加一张植物卡牌。: Adds one plant card to the player's seed slot.
选植物种类；需要改价格和冷却时关闭默认数据并填写对应输入。: Choose the plant type; to change cost and recharge, turn off default data and fill in the matching inputs.
奖励选项被点击 → 添加植物卡牌，设置豌豆射手。: Reward Option Clicked -> Add Plant Card, set to Peashooter.
卡槽满可能失败；种植时触发出口用于追踪这张卡种下的植物。: May fail if the slot is full; the on-plant trigger output is used to track the plant grown from this card.
从卡槽移除指定种类的植物卡牌。: Removes plant cards of the given type from the seed slot.
连接触发并提供植物种类。: Connect the trigger and provide the plant type.
进入某阶段 → 删除卡槽植物卡牌，再添加新的可用卡。: Enter a Stage -> Remove Plant Card from slot, then add a new available card.
会处理该种类的卡牌，不会删除场上已经种下的植物。: Affects cards of that type; it does not remove plants already planted on the field.
对指定植物恢复生命。: Restores health to the given plant.
对象口接具体植物，填写数量；收到触发才生效。: Connect a specific plant to the object port and enter the amount; takes effect only when triggered.
事件的植物口 → 本节点对象口；事件触发 → 本节点触发，填写需要的数量。: Event's plant port -> this node's object port; event trigger -> this node's trigger; enter the amount needed.
确认数字类型和目标有效；植物回血和护盾不是直接修改最大血量。: Make sure the number type and target are valid; plant healing and shields do not directly change max HP.
对指定植物造成伤害。: Deals damage to the given plant.
对指定僵尸造成伤害。: Deals damage to the given zombie.
对象口接具体僵尸，填写数量；收到触发才生效。: Connect a specific zombie to the object port and enter the amount; takes effect only when triggered.
事件的僵尸口 → 本节点对象口；事件触发 → 本节点触发，填写需要的数量。: Event's zombie port -> this node's object port; event trigger -> this node's trigger; enter the amount needed.
对指定植物增加护盾。: Adds a shield to the given plant.
直接移除指定植物并执行死亡处理。: Directly removes the given plant and runs death handling.
连接植物对象与触发信号。: Connect the plant object and the trigger signal.
点击植物时 → 条件分支 → 令植物死亡，同时接入点击的植物对象。: Plant Clicked -> Branch -> Kill Plant, also connecting the clicked plant object.
与造成伤害不同，不保证经过血量归零事件；不要随意接到所有种植事件。: Unlike dealing damage, it does not guarantee passing through the zero-HP event; do not casually connect it to every planting event.
把指定僵尸变为玩家一方。: Turns the given zombie to the player's side.
连接僵尸对象与触发信号。: Connect the zombie object and the trigger signal.
生成僵尸后接本节点，将创建输出的僵尸设为魅惑。: After spawning a zombie, connect this node to hypnotize the zombie from the create output.
输入的是具体僵尸，不是种类；需确认该目标仍有效。: The input is a specific zombie, not a type; make sure the target is still valid.
修改指定植物的攻击加成。: Changes the attack bonus of the given plant.
连接植物对象与触发，给小数输入填写所需加成或倍率。: Connect the plant object and trigger, and enter the bonus or multiplier in the decimal input.
创建植物成功 → 本节点；对象输出接入，修改后观察目标数值。: Plant created successfully -> this node; connect the object output, then check the target values after changing.
输入是加成/倍率，不是直接设置最终攻击或血量；植物使用事件加成通道。未填写时默认: The input is a bonus/multiplier, not a direct final attack or HP value; plants use the event bonus channel. Defaults to 1 if left empty; setting it repeatedly is not the same as multiplying each time.
修改指定植物的生命加成。: Changes the health bonus of the given plant.
修改指定僵尸的生命倍率。: Changes the health multiplier of the given zombie.
连接僵尸对象与触发，给小数输入填写所需加成或倍率。: Connect the zombie object and trigger, and enter the bonus or multiplier in the decimal input.
创建僵尸成功 → 本节点；对象输出接入，修改后观察目标数值。: Zombie created successfully -> this node; connect the object output, then check the target values after changing.
从具体植物读取行、列和种类。: Reads the row, column and type from a specific plant.
输入具体对象，将坐标或种类输出接到对应查询/比较节点。: Input a specific object and connect the coordinate or type outputs to the matching query/compare nodes.
植物事件 → 属性拆分 → 植物类型比较 → 条件分支。: Plant Event -> Split Properties -> Compare Plant Type -> Branch.
它不产生动作，仍需事件触发分支；对象为空时不能把默认坐标当成真实位置。: It performs no action and still needs an event to trigger the branch; if the object is empty, do not treat the default coordinates as a real position.
从具体僵尸读取行、列和种类。: Reads the row, column and type from a specific zombie.
僵尸事件 → 属性拆分 → 僵尸类型比较 → 条件分支。: Zombie Event -> Split Properties -> Compare Zombie Type -> Branch.
取得某格登记的全部植物。: Gets all plants registered on a tile.
填写行列，列表输出接遍历植物列表。: Enter the row and column, and connect the list output to For Each Plant.
鼠标行列 → 获取格子植物 → 遍历植物列表；鼠标触发接遍历。: Mouse Row/Column -> Get Tile Plants -> For Each Plant; connect the mouse trigger to the loop.
会包括睡莲、花盆、飞行等位置层，不只主植物。: Includes position layers such as Lily Pad, Flower Pot and flying plants, not only the main plant.
只查询某格指定位置层的植物。: Queries only the plants on a specific position layer of a tile.
填写行列并选择主植物、花盆、睡莲、南瓜或飞行层。: Enter the row and column and choose the main plant, flower pot, lily pad, pumpkin or flying layer.
鼠标行列 → 本节点（主植物层）→ 遍历植物列表。: Mouse Row/Column -> this node (main plant layer) -> For Each Plant.
位置层不是植物战斗分类；越界或该层为空时返回空列表。: A position layer is not a plant combat category; out-of-bounds or an empty layer returns an empty list.
取得场上登记的植物列表。: Gets the list of plants registered on the field.
列表输出接遍历植物列表，由另一个事件启动遍历。: Connect the list output to For Each Plant; another event starts the loop.
关卡开始 → 遍历植物列表；本节点列表接遍历输入。: Level Start -> For Each Plant; connect this node's list to the loop input.
只连列表不会执行遍历；目标可能在后续行为中死亡。: Connecting only the list does not run the loop; targets may die during later actions.
查询离指定行列最近的僵尸。: Finds the zombie nearest to the given row and column.
提供坐标，再把对象输出接受伤、魅惑或属性拆分。: Provide coordinates, then connect the object output to Take Damage, Hypnotize or Split Properties.
按键事件触发令僵尸受伤；最近僵尸输出接目标。: Key Event triggers Damage Zombie; connect the nearest zombie output to the target.
场上没有合适目标时可能为空；查询不会自行造成伤害。: May be empty when there is no suitable target on the field; the query does not deal damage by itself.
读取这次执行链最近记录的鼠标或实体位置。: Reads the mouse or entity position most recently recorded by this execution chain.
启用保留触发数据，先判断有位置，再用行列输出。等待后仍保留触发时的坐标，不随当前: Enable keep trigger data, first check that a position exists, then use the row/column outputs. After a wait it still keeps the coordinates from the trigger and does not follow the current mouse movement.
点击战场 → 等待1秒 → 在原点击格创建植物；本节点的行列接创建坐标。: Click Battlefield -> Wait 1 sec -> Create Plant on the originally clicked tile; connect this node's row/column to the create coordinates.
实体死亡后坐标仍可读取，原目标不一定存活；没有位置时有位置为false、行列为0: Coordinates stay readable after the entity dies, and the original target may not be alive; with no position, Has Position is false and row/column are 0. With the old reading method there is no position snapshot, so default coordinates cannot be used to judge the original position.
依次处理列表中的每个植物。: Processes each plant in the list in turn.
列表接输入，事件接触发；循环体接需要重复的行为，并使用当前元素。: Connect the list to the input and the event to the trigger; connect the loop body to the actions to repeat, and use the current element.
获取场上全部植物 → 遍历；循环体连接对应对象/种类的动作。: Get All Plants on Field -> For Each; connect the loop body to actions for the matching object/type.
同一帧同步遍历，不会等待循环体里的等待节点；旧取值方式延迟后可能读到最后的元素。: Runs synchronously in the same frame and does not wait for Wait nodes inside the loop body; with the old reading method, after a delay it may read the last element.
依次处理列表中的每个植物种类。: Processes each plant type in the list in turn.
获取植物类型列表 → 遍历；循环体连接对应对象/种类的动作。: Get Plant Type List -> For Each; connect the loop body to actions for the matching object/type.
在节点选择种类，输出接创建或类型比较。: Choose a type in the node and connect the output to Create or Compare Type.
植物类型 → 创建植物的类型输入；另接正式开始触发创建。: Plant Type -> Create Plant type input; also connect the Game Start trigger to create.
种类不是场上对象，不需要触发信号。: A type is not an object on the field and needs no trigger signal.
僵尸类型 → 创建僵尸的类型输入；另接正式开始触发创建。: Zombie Type -> Create Zombie type input; also connect the Game Start trigger to create.
判断两个植物种类是否相同。: Checks whether two plant types are the same.
两个种类接输入，比较结果接分支条件。: Connect two types to the inputs and the comparison result to a branch condition.
属性拆分得到种类，与固定植物类型比较；事件触发分支。: Split Properties gives the type, compared with a fixed plant type; the event triggers the branch.
比较只产生真假值，不会自行执行真分支。: The comparison only produces true or false and does not run the True branch by itself.
判断两个僵尸种类是否相同。: Checks whether two zombie types are the same.
属性拆分得到种类，与固定僵尸类型比较；事件触发分支。: Split Properties gives the type, compared with a fixed zombie type; the event triggers the branch.
把一种植物包装为列表。: Wraps one plant type into a list.
类型口接植物类型，列表口用于合并、随机或遍历。: Connect the type port to a plant type, and use the list port to merge, randomize or loop.
植物类型 → 单植物类型列表 → 合并植物类型列表。: Plant Type -> Single Plant Type List -> Merge Plant Type Lists.
得到的是种类列表，不是场上的植物对象列表。: The result is a list of types, not a list of plant objects on the field.
在一个节点中配置多个植物种类。: Configures multiple plant types in one node.
使用节点内列表编辑，输出接随机选择或遍历。: Use the in-node list editor and connect the output to Random Pick or For Each.
多植物类型列表 → 随机获取植物类型 → 添加植物卡牌。: Multi Plant Type List -> Random Plant Type -> Add Plant Card.
列表为空时后续随机可能得不到有效种类。: If the list is empty, a later random pick may not get a valid type.
把两份植物种类列表合在一起。: Merges two plant type lists into one.
两个列表接输入，使用合并结果或长度。: Connect two lists to the inputs and use the merged result or its length.
两份单植物类型列表 → 合并 → 随机获取植物类型。: Two Single Plant Type Lists -> Merge -> Random Plant Type.
合并不代表自动执行后续动作；重复种类要按玩法需求自行检查。: Merging does not automatically run later actions; check for duplicate types yourself as your gameplay requires.
在这一局里保存并修改植物种类列表。: Stores and edits a plant type list for this run.
将列表送入存储节点，按节点操作选择设置、添加或删除并触发。: Send the list into the storage node, choose Set, Add or Remove and trigger it.
开始时设置奖励池；选过奖励后删除对应种类，再读取剩余列表。: Set the reward pool at start; after a reward is picked, remove that type, then read the remaining list.
与整数等属性变量不同；运行修改不会自动写回编辑器初始列表。: Unlike integer and other property variables; runtime changes are not written back to the editor's initial list.
从输入列表抽取一种植物。: Picks one plant from the input list.
输入非空种类列表，输出接卡牌或创建植物的类型口。: Input a non-empty type list and connect the output to a card or the type port of Create Plant.
多植物类型列表 → 随机获取植物类型 → 创建植物卡牌；事件触发创建。: Multi Plant Type List -> Random Plant Type -> Create Plant Card; an event triggers the creation.
按读取抽取，多次读取可能不同；不要把空列表当成有效奖励池。: Picks on each read, so repeated reads may differ; do not treat an empty list as a valid reward pool.
从植物种类列表移除指定种类。: Removes the given type from a plant type list.
连接原列表与待删除种类，使用结果列表和成功输出。: Connect the original list and the type to remove, and use the result list and success output.
奖励池列表与刚选种类 → 删除植物类型 → 后续列表处理。: Reward pool list and the type just picked -> Remove Plant Type -> later list handling.
使用结果列表才能得到删除结果；它不是删除场上植物或卡槽卡牌。: Use the result list to get the removal result; it does not remove plants on the field or cards in the seed slot.
在游戏屏幕上显示一段提示。: Shows a hint on the game screen.
填写文本与持续时间，连接触发输入。: Enter the text and duration, and connect the trigger input.
第5波真分支 → 显示文本，内容填“首领来了”。: Wave 5 True branch -> Show Text, content "The boss is coming".
只接文本数据不会显示；持续时间使用秒。: Connecting only text data will not show it; duration is in seconds.
播放已有的游戏音效。: Plays an existing game sound effect.
选择或填写有效音效编号，并连接触发信号。: Choose or enter a valid sound ID and connect the trigger signal.
音效编号对应游戏资源，不是本地文件路径；错误编号不会得到想要的声音。: The sound ID refers to game resources, not a local file path; a wrong ID will not give the sound you want.
让指定僵尸切换动画。: Makes the given zombie switch animation.
连接僵尸对象，填写该对象实际存在的动画名。: Connect the zombie object and enter an animation name that actually exists on it.
生成僵尸成功 → 播放僵尸动画，填写walk。: Zombie spawned successfully -> Play Zombie Animation, enter walk.
动画名区分实际资源；此节点只控制表现，不会自动添加攻击伤害。: Animation names depend on the actual resources; this node only controls visuals and does not add attack damage.
给玩家增加指定数量的阳光。: Gives the player the given amount of sun.
填写整数数量并连接触发。: Enter an integer amount and connect the trigger.
奖励选项被点击 → 获得阳光，数量填50。: Reward Option Clicked -> Gain Sun, amount 50.
数量是整数；重复触发会重复发放，需要一次奖励时前面接“只执行一次”。: The amount is an integer; repeated triggers pay out repeatedly, so put "Run Once" before it if you need a one-time reward.
给玩家增加指定数量的金币。: Gives the player the given amount of coins.
奖励选项被点击 → 获得金币，数量填50。: Reward Option Clicked -> Gain Coins, amount 50.
尝试扣除指定数量的阳光。: Tries to spend the given amount of sun.
填写消耗数量，成功口接购买效果，失败口接提示。: Enter the cost; connect the success output to the purchase effect and the failure output to a hint.
交互事件 → 消耗阳光；成功给奖励，失败显示不足提示。: Interact Event -> Spend Sun; on success give a reward, on failure show a not-enough hint.
不要把奖励接在事件另一条并行线上，否则消耗失败也可能得到奖励。: Do not connect the reward to another parallel line of the event, or the reward may be given even if the spending fails.
尝试扣除指定数量的金币。: Tries to spend the given amount of coins.
交互事件 → 消耗金币；成功给奖励，失败显示不足提示。: Interact Event -> Spend Coins; on success give a reward, on failure show a not-enough hint.
读取玩家当前持有的阳光数量。: Reads the amount of sun the player currently has.
输出整数接比较或运算。: Connect the integer output to a comparison or calculation.
当前阳光与100比较 → 分支条件；交互事件触发分支。: Current sun compared with 100 -> Branch condition; an interact event triggers the branch.
只是查询，不会增加或扣除阳光；购买行为建议使用消耗阳光的成功分支。: It is only a query and does not add or spend sun; for purchases, use the success branch of Spend Sun.
给本局增加指定旅行词条。: Adds the given Odyssey modifier to this run.
在节点配置词条类别与条目，连接触发执行。: Configure the modifier category and entry in the node, and connect the trigger to run it.
奖励选择 → 获得旅行词条，选择你要提供的强化。: Reward Choice -> Gain Odyssey Modifier, pick the boost you want to offer.
旧版“已过时”节点保留兼容，新规则优先使用行为分类中的“获得旅行词条”。: The old "Obsolete" node is kept for compatibility; for new rules, prefer "Gain Odyssey Modifier" in the Action category.
在真正失败的条件分支上连接触发，可填写原因。: Connect the trigger on a branch that is a real failure condition; a reason can be entered.
守护目标失败条件 → 令游戏结束，原因填“目标被摧毁”。: Guard target failure condition -> Game Over, reason "Target destroyed".
不要连接到无条件开始事件；失败结算会结束当前战斗。: Do not connect it to an unconditional start event; the defeat result ends the current battle.
主动让这一局进入胜利结算。: Actively sends this run to the victory result.
在任务完成分支连接触发。: Connect the trigger on the quest-complete branch.
达成计数目标 → 条件分支真 → 令游戏胜利。: Count target reached -> Branch True -> Game Win.
仅获取一个比较结果不会结算，仍需要执行信号。: Just getting a comparison result will not end the level; an execute signal is still needed.
在指定位置创建墓碑。: Creates a gravestone at the given position.
填写行列及节点提供的附加参数，再连接触发。: Enter the row and column and the extra parameters the node provides, then connect the trigger.
指定波次 → 创建墓碑，将行列设为需要的位置。: Specified Wave -> Spawn Gravestone, set row/column to the position you need.
行列从0开始；墓碑、弹坑、冰块等可能改变种植空间。白烟只有表现效果，冰块内部植物: Rows and columns start at 0; gravestones, craters, ice blocks etc. may change planting space. White smoke is only a visual effect; plants inside ice blocks must be configured separately.
在指定位置创建白烟特效。: Creates a white smoke effect at the given position.
指定波次 → 创建白烟特效，将行列设为需要的位置。: Specified Wave -> Spawn White Smoke Effect, set row/column to the position you need.
在指定位置创建梯子。: Creates a ladder at the given position.
指定波次 → 创建梯子，将行列设为需要的位置。: Specified Wave -> Spawn Ladder, set row/column to the position you need.
在指定位置创建弹坑。: Creates a crater at the given position.
指定波次 → 创建弹坑，将行列设为需要的位置。: Specified Wave -> Spawn Crater, set row/column to the position you need.
在指定位置创建冰块。: Creates an ice block at the given position.
指定波次 → 创建冰块，将行列设为需要的位置。: Specified Wave -> Spawn Ice Block, set row/column to the position you need.
直接产生寒冰菇冻结效果。: Directly produces an Ice-shroom freeze effect.
设置节点提供的位置、时间或伤害参数，触发后作用于全场。: Set the position, time or damage parameters the node provides; once triggered it affects the whole field.
技能按键事件 → 寒冰菇冻结效果，填写相应参数后试玩范围。: Skill Key Event -> Ice-shroom freeze effect; fill in the parameters, then playtest the range.
这是直接效果，不会先种一株植物；不同爆炸的敌我目标和弹坑行为不同，先在测试关验证: This is a direct effect and does not plant a plant first; different explosions affect allies and enemies differently and behave differently with craters, so test it in a test level first.
设置节点提供的位置、时间或伤害参数，触发后作用于指定行。: Set the position, time or damage parameters the node provides; once triggered it affects the given row.
技能按键事件 → 火爆辣椒效果，填写相应参数后试玩范围。: Skill Key Event -> Jalapeno effect; fill in the parameters, then playtest the range.
直接产生毁灭菇爆炸效果。: Directly produces a Doom-shroom explosion effect.
设置节点提供的位置、时间或伤害参数，触发后作用于指定行列附近。: Set the position, time or damage parameters the node provides; once triggered it affects the area around the given row and column.
技能按键事件 → 毁灭菇爆炸效果，填写相应参数后试玩范围。: Skill Key Event -> Doom-shroom explosion effect; fill in the parameters, then playtest the range.
直接产生樱桃爆炸效果。: Directly produces a Cherry Bomb explosion effect.
技能按键事件 → 樱桃爆炸效果，填写相应参数后试玩范围。: Skill Key Event -> Cherry Bomb explosion effect; fill in the parameters, then playtest the range.
直接产生小丑爆炸效果。: Directly produces a Clown explosion effect.
设置节点提供的位置、时间或伤害参数，触发后作用于指定位置附近。: Set the position, time or damage parameters the node provides; once triggered it affects the area around the given position.
技能按键事件 → 小丑爆炸效果，填写相应参数后试玩范围。: Skill Key Event -> Clown explosion effect; fill in the parameters, then playtest the range.
为奖励菜单增加一个可点击选项。: Adds a clickable option to the reward menu.
填写标题、说明和展示内容；列表输出接下一个选项或菜单，点击出口接奖励动作。: Enter the title, description and display content; connect the list output to the next option or menu, and the click output to the reward action.
三个添加选项依次串列表 → 显示菜单；各自点击出口分别接阳光、金币、卡牌。: Three Add Option nodes chained into a list -> Show Menu; their click outputs connect to Sun, Coins and Card respectively.
选项在菜单读取列表时构造，不靠额外触发逐个添加。请配套使用“奖励选择”分类菜单。: Options are built when the menu reads the list, not added one by one by extra triggers. Use it with the "Reward Choice" category menu.
选项在菜单读取列表时构造，不靠额外触发逐个添加。这是旧GameObject选项口: Options are built when the menu reads the list, not added one by one by extra triggers. This is the old GameObject option port; use it with the old multi-choice menu, and do not connect it to a regular mouse item.
打开多选菜单，让玩家选择奖励。: Opens a multi-choice menu so the player can pick a reward.
选项列表接输入，事件触发接触发口；设置展示数量、刷新和取消。: Connect the option list to the input and the event trigger to the trigger port; set the display count, refresh and cancel.
清场事件 → 显示菜单；三个选项串成列表后接入，窗口数设3。: Clear Field Event -> Show Menu; chain three options into a list and connect it, with window count set to 3.
窗口数限制1～5。使用专用奖励选项列表。菜单会暂停游戏，选择或正常退出后继续。: Window count is limited to 1-5. Use the dedicated reward option list. The menu pauses the game, and it resumes after a choice or a normal exit.
窗口数限制1～5。旧选项口虽然叫物品对象，实际要传选项列表。菜单会暂停游戏，选择: Window count is limited to 1-5. Although the old option port is called an item object, it actually takes an option list. The menu pauses the game, and it resumes after a choice or a normal exit.
把两个奖励选项列表合成一个。: Combines two reward option lists into one.
列表A、B接对应选项，输出接菜单或继续合并。: Connect lists A and B to the matching options, and connect the output to a menu or keep merging.
两个独立选项列表 → 合并选项 → 显示对应类型的菜单。: Two separate option lists -> Merge Options -> Show Menu of the matching type.
新专用选项与旧GameObject选项不能混接；合并本身不打开菜单。 取消合并默: New dedicated options and old GameObject options cannot be mixed; merging itself does not open a menu. Cancel Merge defaults to false; true outputs only A and does not read B.
创建用于展示信息并响应点击的卡牌。: Creates a card that shows information and responds to clicks.
设置显示内容，连接创建触发；点击出口接交互动作。: Set the display content and connect the create trigger; connect the click output to the interaction action.
正式开始 → 创建信息卡牌；卡牌点击 → 显示任务提示。: Game Start -> Create Info Card; Card Clicked -> Show quest hint.
它用于信息交互，不等同可种植的植物卡；图结束后旧点击回调失效。: It is for information interaction and is not the same as a plantable plant card; after the graph ends, old click callbacks become invalid.
根据真假条件，选择执行哪一条路线。: Chooses which route to run based on a true/false condition.
事件接触发，比较结果接条件；真假出口分别连接后续动作。: Connect the event to the trigger and the comparison result to the condition; connect the True and False outputs to the follow-up actions.
当前阳光 ≥ 100 → 条件；按键触发分支，真/假各显示不同文本。: Current sun >= 100 -> Condition; key trigger branches, True/False each show different text.
条件未接默认false。“假（停止）”仍会执行连接的假分支，不是绝对停止所有规则: An unconnected condition defaults to false. "False (Stop)" still runs the connected False branch; it does not absolutely stop all rules.
收到信号后等待若干秒，再执行后续动作。: After receiving a signal, waits a number of seconds, then runs the following actions.
填写等待时间，触发输出接后续动作。: Enter the wait time and connect the trigger output to the follow-up actions.
正式开始 → 等待（5秒）→ 显示文本。: Game Start -> Wait (5 sec) -> Show Text.
每次触发都单独等待；游戏暂停时计时停止。旧关卡延迟后可能读到最新事件，退出图会取: Each trigger waits separately; the timer stops while the game is paused. In old levels, after a delay it may read the latest event; leaving the graph cancels the wait.
在同一帧内重复执行循环体。: Repeats the loop body within the same frame.
填写循环次数，循环体接动作，当前索引从0开始。: Enter the loop count, connect actions to the loop body; the current index starts at 0.
循环3次 → 创建植物；索引接列，可依次使用列0、1、2。: Loop 3 times -> Create Plant; connect the index to the column, so columns 0, 1, 2 are used in turn.
不是每秒执行一次，也不会等待循环体完成异步任务；间隔执行用周期切换。过大次数会触: It does not run once per second and does not wait for the loop body to finish async tasks; use Cycle Toggle for interval runs. A count that is too large triggers execution protection.
开启或关闭一个按固定间隔重复的动作。: Turns a repeating action on or off at a fixed interval.
第一次触发开启，第二次触发关闭；周期事件接重复行为。: First trigger turns it on, second trigger turns it off; connect the cycle event to the repeated action.
正式开始 → 周期切换；周期间隔5 → 每次获得25阳光。: Game Start -> Cycle Toggle; cycle interval 5 -> gain 25 sun each time.
首次周期在等待一个间隔后执行；下限0.1秒，暂停时停表。开启/关闭出口不是周期出: The first cycle runs after waiting one interval; minimum 0.1 sec, and the timer stops while paused. The On/Off outputs are not the cycle output.
从连接的多个目标中随机执行指定数量。: Randomly runs a given number of the connected targets.
多个候选动作接到同一输出口，设置抽取数量和是否允许重复。: Connect several candidate actions to the same output, and set the pick count and whether repeats are allowed.
按键事件 → 随机触发 → 三个不同提示节点。: Key Event -> Random Trigger -> three different hint nodes.
不允许重复时数量不会超过候选目标数；它选的是执行路线，不是随机数。: When repeats are not allowed, the count will not exceed the number of candidates; it picks an execution route, not a random number.
记录触发次数，供目标进度和条件判断使用。: Records the number of triggers, for use in goal progress and condition checks.
事件接触发，次数输出接整数比较；可设置初始值和重置输入。: Connect the event to the trigger and the count output to an integer comparison; an initial value and reset input can be set.
僵尸死亡 → 计数器；次数等于10 → 分支 → 提示完成。: Zombie Dies -> Counter; count equals 10 -> Branch -> show Complete.
第一次执行先载入初始值再计数；重置会归零，而不是恢复初始值。: The first run loads the initial value, then counts. Reset sets it to zero, not back to the initial value.
每次触发在开与关之间切换。: Toggles between on and off each time it is triggered.
触发输入负责翻转，状态输出提供真假，状态改变出口执行动作。: The trigger input flips it, the state output gives true/false, and the state-changed exit runs actions.
按键 → 开关；状态接分支条件，状态改变接分支触发。: Key Press -> Switch; connect the state to a Branch condition and the state-changed exit to the Branch trigger.
读取状态不会自动翻转；每局运行状态与菜单中的配置分开。: Reading the state does not flip it automatically. Per-match runtime state is kept separate from the configuration in the menu.
仅在同步执行下游期间输出true。: Outputs true only while the synchronous downstream is executing.
触发后把布尔输出交给同步的下游条件。: After triggering, passes a boolean output to the synchronous downstream condition.
事件 → 脉冲；脉冲执行出口接分支，布尔输出接条件。: Event -> Pulse; connect the pulse execution exit to a Branch and the boolean output to a condition.
同步调用结束立即复位，不是下一帧。延迟读取在旧方式下可能已变false，新方式可: Resets immediately when the synchronous call ends, not on the next frame. With the old method a delayed read may already be false; the new method can keep the value from that moment.
输入接真假值，输出接条件分支。: Connect a true/false value to the input and the output to a conditional Branch.
true输入后输出false；另用事件信号启动分支。: After a true input, outputs false; use a separate event signal to start the Branch.
它是条件计算，不会自行触发动作。: It is a condition calculation and never triggers actions by itself.
判断两个条件是否都成立。: Checks whether both conditions are true.
有足够阳光且达到指定波次；另用事件信号启动分支。: Enough Sun and the specified wave reached; use a separate event signal to start the Branch.
判断两个条件是否至少成立一个。: Checks whether at least one of the two conditions is true.
击败首领或达到目标计数；另用事件信号启动分支。: Defeat the Boss or reach the target count; use a separate event signal to start the Branch.
比较两个整数，输出相应真假结果。: Compares two integers and outputs the matching true/false result.
两个输入连入数据，所需结果接条件分支。: Connect data to both inputs and the desired result to a conditional Branch.
比较波次与5，把等于接到分支条件。: Compare Wave with 5 and connect Equal to the Branch condition.
类型必须对应；对象比较的是同一个实例，不是名字或植物种类相同。: Types must match. Objects are compared by being the same instance, not by having the same name or plant type.
比较两个小数，输出相应真假结果。: Compares two decimals and outputs the matching true/false result.
比较两个物品对象，输出相应真假结果。: Compares two item objects and outputs the matching true/false result.
比较鼠标手上的物品与目标物品对象，把相等接条件。: Compare the item in the mouse hand with the target item object and connect Equal to a condition.
给多个节点提供固定整数。: Provides a fixed integer to multiple nodes.
在节点里填写值，再把输出连到相同类型的输入。: Enter a value in the node, then connect the output to an input of the same type.
填写25，连接到需要此值的行为输入；另接事件触发行为。: Enter 25 and connect it to the action input that needs it; also connect an event to trigger the action.
常量无需触发；若只给一个未连接输入填数，也可以直接用工具栏“填写输入值”。: Constants need no trigger. If you only need to fill in one unconnected input, you can also use the toolbar's "Fill Input Value".
给多个节点提供固定小数。: Provides a fixed decimal to multiple nodes.
填写0.5，连接到需要此值的行为输入；另接事件触发行为。: Enter 0.5 and connect it to the action input that needs it; also connect an event to trigger the action.
给多个节点提供固定真假。: Provides a fixed true/false value to multiple nodes.
填写true，连接到需要此值的行为输入；另接事件触发行为。: Enter true and connect it to the action input that needs it; also connect an event to trigger the action.
给多个节点提供固定文本。: Provides fixed text to multiple nodes.
填写首领来了，连接到需要此值的行为输入；另接事件触发行为。: Enter "Boss incoming" and connect it to the action input that needs it; also connect an event to trigger the action.
连接两个同类型数字，将结果接到行为、比较或设置变量输入。: Connect two numbers of the same type and send the result to an action, comparison or Set Variable input.
输入2与3，加法结果为5；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 2 and 3 give a sum of 5; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
整数和小数端口不混接；除法与取模应避免除数0。整数除法舍去小数部分。: Integer and decimal ports cannot be mixed. Avoid a divisor of 0 in division and modulo. Integer division drops the fractional part.
输入5与2，减法结果为3；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 5 and 2 give a difference of 3; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
输入2与3，乘法结果为6；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 2 and 3 give a product of 6; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
输入6与2，除法结果为3；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 6 and 2 give a quotient of 3; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
输入2与3，整数加法结果为5；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 2 and 3 give an integer sum of 5; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
输入5与2，整数减法结果为3；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 5 and 2 give an integer difference of 3; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
输入2与3，整数乘法结果为6；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 2 and 3 give an integer product of 6; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
输入7与2，整数除法结果为3；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 7 and 2 give an integer quotient of 3; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
输入7与2，整数取模结果为1；用事件触发读取结果的动作。: Inputs 7 and 2 give an integer remainder of 1; use an event to trigger the action that reads the result.
把两段文字按顺序拼在一起。: Joins two pieces of text together in order.
两个文本接输入，输出接显示文本。: Connect two texts to the inputs and the output to Show Text.
“当前奖励：”与“阳光”拼接，再触发显示。: Join "Current reward: " and "Sun", then trigger the display.
数字需要先转成文本；拼接不自动添加空格或换行。: Numbers must be converted to text first. Joining adds no spaces or line breaks automatically.
在范围内抽取随机整数。: Draws a random integer within a range.
填写最小值和最大值，输出接奖励数量或其他数值输入。: Enter the minimum and maximum; connect the output to a reward amount or other number input.
范围设10～50 → 获得阳光数量；小数先按需要转整数。: Range 10-50 -> Sun amount gained; convert decimals to integers first if needed.
每次读取都可能重新随机。需要多个动作使用同一个结果时，先写入变量再读取。整数包含: Every read may roll a new random value. If several actions need the same result, write it to a variable first and then read it. Both ends of the integer range are included.
在范围内抽取随机小数。: Draws a random decimal within a range.
引用关卡变量面板中一个共享整数变量。: References a shared integer variable from the Level Variables panel.
从关卡变量面板拖入；变量口连接对应获取或设置节点。: Drag it in from the Level Variables panel; connect the variable port to the matching Get or Set node.
变量引用 → 获取整数 → 比较或运算。: Variable Reference -> Get Integer -> Compare or Calculate.
同一个变量拖入多次仍共享值；普通复制共享原变量，模板插入会复制独立变量。: Dragging the same variable in several times still shares one value. A normal copy shares the original variable, while inserting a template creates independent variables.
读取整数变量目前保存的值。: Reads the value currently stored in an integer variable.
变量输入连接关卡变量面板拖入的变量引用，输出提供普通数值。: Connect the variable input to a variable reference dragged in from the Level Variables panel; the output provides a plain number.
变量引用 → 获取值 → 加法/比较 → 后续行为。: Variable Reference -> Get Value -> Add/Compare -> following actions.
没有触发口，只读取当前值；读取不会自动执行上游设置动作。: It has no trigger port and only reads the current value; reading does not automatically run upstream Set actions.
把新值存进共享整数变量。: Stores a new value into a shared integer variable.
连接变量引用、新值和触发；完成出口连接依赖新值的后续动作。: Connect the variable reference, the new value and a trigger; connect the done exit to the following actions that depend on the new value.
事件 → 设置变量；完成 → 显示或检查更新后的结果。: Event -> Set Variable; Done -> show or check the updated result.
只接新值不触发就不会写入；变量输出也能串联其他设置节点，但动作顺序仍需执行线。: Connecting only the new value without a trigger writes nothing. The variable output can also chain other Set nodes, but action order still needs an execution line.
引用关卡变量面板中一个共享小数变量。: References a shared decimal variable from the Level Variables panel.
变量引用 → 获取浮点数 → 比较或运算。: Variable Reference -> Get Float -> Compare or Calculate.
读取小数变量目前保存的值。: Reads the value currently stored in a decimal variable.
把新值存进共享小数变量。: Stores a new value into a shared decimal variable.
引用关卡变量面板中一个共享真假变量。: References a shared true/false variable from the Level Variables panel.
变量引用 → 获取布尔 → 比较或运算。: Variable Reference -> Get Boolean -> Compare or Calculate.
读取真假变量目前保存的值。: Reads the value currently stored in a true/false variable.
把新值存进共享真假变量。: Stores a new value into a shared true/false variable.
把整数转换为小数类型。: Converts an integer to the decimal type.
整数输入，小数输出接需要小数的端口。: Integer input; the decimal output connects to ports that need a decimal.
整数5 → 整数转浮点数 → 等待时间。: Integer 5 -> Integer to Float -> Wait Time.
数值5变为5.0，不会缩放成0.05。: The value 5 becomes 5.0 and is not scaled to 0.05.
把小数转换为整数，截去小数部分。: Converts a decimal to an integer by cutting off the fractional part.
小数输入，整数输出接计数、阳光数量等。: Decimal input; the integer output connects to counts, Sun amounts, etc.
2.9转换后得到2，再给需要整数的输入。: 2.9 becomes 2 after conversion, then goes to an input that needs an integer.
不是四舍五入；负数也向0截断。: It does not round; negative numbers also truncate toward 0.
把数字转换成用于显示的文字。: Converts a number into text for display.
输入小数，在节点设置要保留的小数位数。: Enter a decimal and set the number of decimal places to keep in the node.
数值 → 小数转字符串 → 显示文本的文本口。: Value -> Decimal to String -> text port of Show Text.
输出是文本，不能再直接接数值计算；小数位数范围0～6。: The output is text and cannot be connected directly to number calculations again. Decimal places range from 0 to 6.
变量引用的基础实现，供具体变量节点使用。: Base implementation of variable references, used by the specific variable nodes.
从关卡变量面板创建整数、小数或布尔变量，不直接创建此基础节点。: Create integer, decimal or boolean variables from the Level Variables panel; this base node is not created directly.
使用整数变量引用 → 获取整数。: Use Integer Variable Reference -> Get Integer.
此类型不在右键创建菜单中，不作为玩家独立使用的节点。: This type is not in the right-click create menu and is not meant to be used on its own by players.
字符串变量引用 → 获取字符串 → 显示文本的内容。: String Variable Reference -> Get String -> content of Show Text.
未连接时返回空字符串；读取不会执行写入操作。: Returns an empty string when unconnected; reading does not perform any write.
正式开场 → 设置字符串；变量连接“任务文字”，新值填写“守住首领”。: Official Start -> Set String; connect the variable to "Mission Text" and enter "Defend the Boss" as the new value.
对象为空、类型不匹配或输入越界时使用失败输出/默认值，不会创建无效实体。: If the object is empty, the type does not match or the input is out of range, the failure output/default value is used and no invalid entity is created.
敌人死亡 → 整数变量运算；选择“加”，操作数填1，即自增计数。: Enemy Dies -> Integer Variable Math; choose "Add" and enter 1 as the operand, which makes a counter that increments.
除零或溢出时走失败口，原值不变。整数除法向0截断，未填写操作数默认为1。: Division by zero or overflow takes the failure exit and the original value stays unchanged. Integer division truncates toward 0, and an unfilled operand defaults to 1.
敌人死亡 → 小数变量运算；选择“加”，操作数填1，即自增计数。: Enemy Dies -> Decimal Variable Math; choose "Add" and enter 1 as the operand, which makes a counter that increments.
数值8、底数2 → 对数结果3；数值2、指数3 → 幂结果8。: Value 8, base 2 -> logarithm result 3; value 2, exponent 3 -> power result 8.
对数要求数值和底数大于0、底数不为1；无法表示的结果返回0且有效为假。: A logarithm requires the value and base to be greater than 0 and the base not equal to 1; an unrepresentable result returns 0 and Valid is false.
整数计数 → 整数转布尔 → 条件分支。: Integer Count -> Integer to Boolean -> Conditional Branch.

未连接或空列表返回0。: An unconnected or empty list returns 0.
领取奖励 → 列表删除项（索引0），下一项成为新的第0项。: Claim Reward -> List Remove Item (index 0); the next item becomes the new item 0.
索引从0开始，越界走失败口。: Indexes start at 0; out of range takes the failure exit.
阶段开始 → 复制列表内容：默认奖励池复制到本轮奖励池。: Phase Start -> Copy List Contents: copy the default reward pool into this round's reward pool.
两列表元素类型必须一致。复制容器和值；对象元素仍指向同一个场景对象，不克隆对象。: Both lists must have the same element type. The container and values are copied; object elements still point to the same scene object and are not cloned.
新一轮开始 → 清空列表“本轮已击败目标”。: New Round Start -> Clear List "Defeated Targets This Round".
所有引用同一列表的节点立即看到空列表。: Every node that references the same list immediately sees an empty list.
接遍历僵尸列表，为全场僵尸设置寒冷。: Connect to Loop Over Zombie List to apply Chill to every zombie on the field.
只在读取时枚举棋盘，不进行常驻扫描；列表同时包含敌方及魅惑僵尸，可接僵尸拆分进一: Enumerates the board only when read, with no constant scanning; the list includes both enemy and Hypnotized zombies, and you can connect Zombie Split to filter further.
全场僵尸 → 僵尸列表；每次循环 → 修改僵尸状态。: All Zombies on Field -> Zombie List; each loop -> Modify Zombie Status.
输入会复制一次，循环中击杀或生成僵尸不会改变本轮集合。旧版延时读取仍沿用旧语义，: The input is copied once; killing or spawning zombies during the loop does not change this round's set. Old-style delayed reads keep the old behavior, while delays in new graphs keep the object of each loop.
下拉框选择状态。寒冷、中毒、冻结和传送填写秒数；红温/余烬填0解除、正数开启；蒜: Choose the status from the dropdown. Chill, Poison, Freeze and Chronoshift take seconds; Conflagration/Irradiation: 0 removes, a positive number enables; Garlic/Tangle/Freeze values take the target stack count.
选择寒冷，数值5，触发后持续5秒。: Choose Chill with value 5; after triggering it lasts 5 seconds.
使用游戏现有状态入口，保留免疫、元素反应和冻结规则。0表示移除该状态；传送解除仍: Uses the game's existing status entry, keeping immunity, elemental reaction and Freeze rules. 0 removes the status; removing Chronoshift still deals damage per game rules. Conflagration and Irradiation originally have no countdown.
选择冻结值，接小数比较节点判断是否达到50。: Choose Freeze Value and connect a decimal compare node to check whether it reaches 50.
红温/余烬返回1或0；寒冷/中毒/冻结/传送返回剩余秒数；其余返回层数。空对象返: Conflagration/Irradiation return 1 or 0; Chill/Poison/Freeze/Chronoshift return remaining seconds; the rest return stack count. An empty object returns 0/false.
诅咒值50，给目标植物追加50诅咒。: Curse value 50: adds 50 Curse to the target plant.
采用游戏诅咒机制，会随时间增长并可能致死；正数追加，0解除。: Uses the game's Curse mechanic, which grows over time and may be lethal; a positive number adds, 0 removes.
秒数3，强制false，按照地图和植物抗性尝试沉默。: Seconds 3, Force false: tries to Silence according to the map and plant resistance.
本次成功施加沉默立即输出完成；目标为空、已死亡、免疫或秒数无效时输出失败。秒数须: Outputs Done immediately once Silence is applied successfully; outputs Failed if the target is empty, dead, immune or the seconds are invalid. Seconds must be greater than 0 and no more than 100000. Force = true skips the resistance check; Snow time multiplier, charge and recovery effects follow game rules; an existing Silence can still stack, and the output does not wait for recovery.
倍率2让攻击倒计时以两倍基础速度减少。: Multiplier 2 makes the attack countdown decrease at twice the base speed.
允许0.01到100；覆盖当前总加成，之后旅行词条等仍可继续调整。不同植物的攻击: Allows 0.01 to 100; overrides the current total bonus, and Odyssey modifiers etc. can still adjust it afterwards. Different plants' attack animations and unique skills still follow their original rules.
读取倍率后乘以1.2，再写入设置植物攻速。: Read the multiplier, multiply it by 1.2, then write it into Set Plant Attack Speed.
剩余秒数改变当前计时，空输入按0处理并在下一帧完成。最大秒数填-1保留当前周期；: Remaining seconds changes the current timer; an empty input is treated as 0 and completes on the next frame. Max seconds -1 keeps the current cycle; a non-negative value is used for this plant's later attribute countdowns and must be at least this time's remaining seconds.
剩余秒数0、最大秒数5：下一帧触发原技能，之后每次属性倒计时采用5秒。: Remaining seconds 0, max seconds 5: triggers the original skill next frame, and every attribute countdown after that uses 5 seconds.
只影响使用属性倒计时的技能，不改普通攻击间隔。最大秒数0最多每帧完成一次，仍遵守: Only affects skills that use the attribute countdown and does not change the normal attack interval. Max seconds 0 completes at most once per frame, and still follows the plant's original skill restart, pause and death rules.
读取当前属性倒计时和最大秒数。: Reads the current attribute countdown and max seconds.
设置过持续周期时返回该周期，否则返回原进度条最大值。: If a duration cycle has been set, returns that cycle; otherwise returns the original progress bar maximum.
用于制作属性冷却文本或条件触发。: Used to make attribute cooldown text or conditional triggers.
未设置持续周期且没有进度条时，以当前倒计时作为最大值；这不是所有植物通用的技能冷: When no duration cycle is set and there is no progress bar, the current countdown is used as the maximum; this is not a skill cooldown setting common to all plants.
点击指定植物后免费尝试发动一次大招。: After the specified plant is clicked, tries to cast its Ultimate once for free.
直接调用SuperSkill，不扣金币、不升级银色植物、不额外产生金币消费衍生效: Calls SuperSkill directly: no coins spent, no Silver plant upgrade, and no extra coin-spending side effects; if the plant has no Ultimate or cannot cast it right now, it takes the failure exit.
调用植物已有的升级或外挂强化效果。: Calls the plant's existing upgrade or add-on boost effect.
目标等级2、外挂false，免费升到2级。: Target level 2, add-on false: upgrades to level 2 for free.
目标等级0～3且必须高于当前等级；星辉true时尝试StarUp，只有支持星辉的: Target level 0-3 and must be higher than the current level; with Stellar true it tries StarUp, which only succeeds for plants that support Stellar, and does not change global plant data.
设置本体血量、最大血量、攻击力、防具血量、基础移速或体型。: Sets a zombie's body HP, max HP, attack, armor HP, base speed or size.
选择需要修改的数值，连接僵尸对象并填写值。: Pick the stat to change, connect a zombie object and enter a value.
选择基础移速并填2，寒冷等速度倍率仍然有效。: Pick base speed and enter 2; speed multipliers like Chill still apply.
本体血量0执行正常死亡处理，超过原上限会同步提高上限；最大血量至少1，降低时会限: Body HP 0 triggers normal death; going above the old cap raises the cap too. Max HP is at least 1, and lowering it clamps current HP. HP and attack are rounded to integers. Armor setting only affects existing armor; size is limited to 0.1-5, speed to 0-100.
读取本体血量、最大血量、攻击力、防具血量、基础移速或体型。: Reads a zombie's body HP, max HP, attack, armor HP, base speed or size.
选择数值，输入具体僵尸对象；本体血量不包含两类防具。: Pick a stat and enter a specific zombie object; body HP does not include the two armor types.
选择本体血量接小数比较，判断本体是否低于100。: Pick body HP and connect a decimal comparison to check whether the body is below 100.
金币大于等于1000时开放奖励选择。: Reward selection opens when coins are at least 1000.
读取本局金币，不读取或修改存档商店货币。: Reads the coins of the current level; does not read or change saved shop currency.
普通僵尸、价格50、冷却5秒、立即可用true。: Normal zombie, price 50, cooldown 5 seconds, ready immediately: true.
价格/冷却填-1读取关卡数据。立即可用只影响新卡初始状态；每次成功放置后按总秒数: Enter -1 for price/cooldown to read level data. Ready immediately only affects the new card's initial state; after each successful placement the card recharges for the total seconds, and failed placements cost nothing. If slots are full or none is available, it takes the failure path and no off-field card is left behind.
支持普通卡槽和我是僵尸卡槽，未选入卡槽的图库卡牌不删除。0张也正常完成。: Supports normal slots and I, Zombie slots; gallery cards not selected into a slot are not deleted. Deleting 0 cards still completes normally.
创建信息卡的卡牌对象接此节点，全部false。: Connect the card object created by the Create Info Card node here, all false.
不接对象且全部false时删除0张，防止误删其它信息卡。: With no object connected and all false, deletes 0 cards, to avoid deleting other info cards by mistake.
总秒数10、剩余秒数0，立刻冷却完成，之后每次使用冷却10秒。: Total seconds 10, remaining seconds 0: recharges instantly, then each use has a 10-second cooldown.
剩余秒数不得超过总秒数；只影响现有卡牌，之后新增卡使用添加节点参数或关卡僵尸数据: Remaining seconds cannot exceed total seconds; only affects existing cards. Cards added later use the Add node's parameters or the level zombie data.
选择手套，连接设置道具冷却。: Pick the Glove and connect Set Tool Cooldown.
植物预览、僵尸预览、咖啡豆等可以识别持有类型，但没有工具冷却。: Plant previews, zombie previews, Coffee Beans and the like can be detected as held types, but have no tool cooldown.
按真实持有物识别铲子、手套、锤子、桶、加农炮准心等，输出物品对象及种类。: Detects the shovel, glove, hammer, bucket, cannon crosshair and so on by what is actually held, and outputs the item object and its kind.
类型接道具类型比较，判断是否拿着手套。: Connect the type to a Tool Type comparison to check whether the Glove is held.
空手返回“无”和空对象；以鼠标真实持有物为准。: Empty hand returns "None" and an empty object; based on what the mouse is really holding.
鼠标道具类型与“手套”常量比较。: Compares the mouse tool type with the "Glove" constant.
手套、总秒数5、剩余秒数0，立即可用。: Glove, total seconds 5, remaining seconds 0, ready immediately.
总秒数设置持续到本局道具销毁，后续使用仍采用该值；剩余秒数只改变当前一次计时。无: Total seconds lasts until the tool is destroyed this level, and later uses still use that value; remaining seconds only changes the current timer. No-cooldown mode and IZ's built-in no-cooldown rules take priority.
读取手套剩余秒数并转文本显示。: Reads the Glove's remaining seconds and shows it as text.
首次立即检查，之后按间隔检查；条件true触发完成，false继续等待。最多检查: Checks immediately the first time, then at each interval; condition true triggers Done, false keeps waiting. When max checks run out it takes Timeout. Triggering the same node again replaces the earlier wait.
整数变量值>=10接条件，间隔0.2秒；变量达到10时继续。: Integer variable >= 10 connected to the condition, interval 0.2 seconds; continues when the variable reaches 10.
失败表示参数不合法，例如间隔小于0.1秒；条件false不会触发失败。退出关卡或: Failed means invalid parameters, e.g. an interval under 0.1 seconds; a false condition does not trigger Failed. Leaving the level or switching stage cancels the wait. Variables and pure calculations in the condition are re-read; event objects and loop indices keep the original trigger context.
条件未成立时重复执行动作，成立后继续后续流程。: Repeats the action while the condition is not met, then continues the flow once it is.
首次立即检查，条件false触发每次循环，等待指定间隔后再检查；true触发完成: Checks immediately the first time; condition false triggers Each Loop, waits the given interval, then checks again; true triggers Done. When max checks run out it takes Timeout. Triggering the same node again replaces the earlier loop.
条件接整数变量>=10，每次循环接变量加1，间隔0.2秒；达到10后完成。等待条: Connect Integer variable >= 10 to the condition and Variable +1 to Each Loop, interval 0.2 seconds; done after reaching 10. Wait Until only waits, while this node can also repeat actions.
失败表示参数不合法，例如间隔小于0.1秒；条件false触发每次循环。退出关卡或: Failed means invalid parameters, e.g. an interval under 0.1 seconds; condition false triggers Each Loop. Leaving the level or switching stage cancels the loop. Variables and pure calculations in the condition are re-read; event objects and loop indices keep the original trigger context.
触发接伤害僵尸，僵尸口接目标，制作点击消灭僵尸玩法。: Connect the trigger to Damage Zombie and the zombie port to the target to make a click-to-kill game mode.
只在战场有效点击时查询碰撞体，重叠时选择离点击位置最近的一只；不截断原来的卡牌或: Only queries colliders on a valid click on the battlefield; when they overlap, picks the one closest to the click position; does not cut off the original card or tool action.
选择火爆辣椒，触发时行口输出发生火焰的行。: Pick Jalapeno; when triggered, the Row port outputs the row where the fire occurred.
寒冰菇是全场效果，行返回-1。既监听植物造成的效果，也监听节点调用同一游戏效果入: Ice-shroom is a whole-field effect, so the row returns -1. Listens both to effects caused by plants and to nodes calling the same game effect entry; avoid feeding the event back into the same effect, which causes recursion.
关卡开始接本节点，进家失败false，用事件自定义胜负。: Connect Level Start to this node with Home Reached Failure false, and use events to set your own win/loss.
只改变进家判定，保护植物死亡、手动失败等其他失败来源不变。关闭后僵尸继续走，越过: Only changes the reached-home check; other failure sources such as protected plant death or manual failure are unchanged. When turned off, zombies keep walking and leave the field by the original rule once they pass the left boundary.
对话开始暂停true，对话完成再接暂停false。: Pause true when the dialogue starts, then connect pause false when it ends.
暂停下一波计时和残血提前刷新，不中断本波正在生成的僵尸。停止事件图后自动解除。: Pauses the next-wave timer and the low-HP early refresh, without interrupting zombies currently spawning in this wave. Released automatically when the event graph stops.
选择弹坑，行2列3，删除该格昼夜弹坑。: Pick Crater, row 2, column 3, and delete the day/night crater on that tile.
使用各障碍的Die入口，同步清理棋盘占用；冰块指格子冰块，不是冰车留下的整行冰道: Uses each obstacle's Die entry and clears board occupancy in sync; ice block means a tile ice block, not the whole row of ice trail left by the Zamboni. Rows and columns start from 0.
阶段进入事件接此节点，选择该阶段背景音乐。: Connect the stage-enter event to this node and pick that stage's background music.
只使用已加载的游戏音乐；退出关卡仍由原菜单音乐流程接管。不要每帧重复调用，否则会: Only uses game music that is already loaded; leaving the level is still handled by the original menu music flow. Do not call it every frame, or it will restart from the beginning repeatedly.
移除本局指定旅行词条，停止对应持续效果并刷新羁绊。: Removes the specified Odyssey modifier from this level, stops its ongoing effects and refreshes affinities.
选择词条类别，填写内部名称、编号或游戏显示标题；也可填完整描述。未持有的有效词条: Pick the modifier category and enter its internal name, ID or in-game title; a full description also works. A valid modifier that is not held completes normally, with Removed = false; an invalid name or an ambiguous title takes Failed.
选择僵尸词条，名称填势不可挡，可移除内部名为二爷无视植物的词条。: Pick Zombie Modifier and enter the name Unstoppable; can remove the modifier whose internal name is Newspaper Zombie Ignores Plants.
注销该词条监听、停止持续循环；强力打击和电力相生清除独立倍率，硬化按剩余等级刷新: Unregisters the modifier's listeners and stops ongoing loops; Power Strike and Electric Synergy clear their separate multipliers, and Hardening refreshes by remaining level. Resources, cards, entities and permanent value changes already granted are not rolled back; shields or curses already applied end by their own rules. Odyssey modifiers also remove their tier-2 record.
输入融合植物，接遍历植物类型节点逐个查看组成；重复材料会保留。: Enter a fusion plant and connect it to the Iterate Plant Types node to view each ingredient; duplicate ingredients are kept.
采用静态融合配方，不猜测随机融合时的实际历史。无配方返回自身；配方环与异常深度有: Uses static fusion recipes and does not guess the actual history of a random fusion. With no recipe it returns itself; recipe cycles and abnormal depth are guarded against.
X=0、Y=1、Z=0，连接创建场景对象的位置。: X=0, Y=1, Z=0, connected to the position of Create Scene Object.
坐标接创建场景对象；行列接格子动作节点。: Connect coordinates to Create Scene Object; connect row and column to tile action nodes.
鼠标在棋盘外时行列可能越界，实体生成节点会检查范围。: When the mouse is outside the board, row and column may be out of range; the Spawn Entity node checks the range.
图标植物选豌豆射手，在鼠标位置创建一个装饰标记。: Pick Peashooter as the icon plant and create a decorative marker at the mouse position.
这是场景标记，不执行植物攻击或占格。每图最多256个存活对象，退出图时清理；植物: This is a scene marker; it does not attack like a plant or occupy a tile. Each map allows at most 256 live objects and they are cleaned up when leaving the map; for plant/zombie entities use the original create nodes.
名称填路标1，后续用字符串转对象读取路标1。: Enter the name Waypoint1, then use String To Object later to read Waypoint1.
同名绑定覆盖旧值；名称只在当前运行图内有效。池化子弹需使用专用子弹句柄，不能转成: Binding the same name overwrites the old value; names are only valid within the current running map. Pooled bullets need a dedicated bullet handle and cannot be converted into long-term scene objects.
将对象引用文本存入字符串列表，再通过字符串转对象读取。: Stores the object reference text in a string list, then reads it back through String To Object.
文本是本次运行的引用令牌，不是对象名字或跨关卡存档ID。空对象、池化子弹或超过1: The text is a reference token for this run, not an object name or a cross-level save ID. Returns an empty string for an empty object, a pooled bullet, or when over 1024 references are valid at once.
文本填路标1，读取绑定场景对象节点保存的路标。: Enter Waypoint1 as the text to read the waypoint saved by the Bind Scene Object node.
失效、已销毁或另一场运行的引用返回空。不会按名字全场扫描，也不会创建对象。: A stale, destroyed or other-run reference returns empty. It does not scan the whole field by name and does not create objects.
用于对象绑定、对象列表或读取坐标。: Used for object binding, object lists or reading coordinates.
对象列表取项后转为植物，接已有战斗节点。: Takes an item from the object list and converts it to a plant, connecting to existing combat nodes.
对象列表取项后转为僵尸，接已有战斗节点。: Takes an item from the object list and converts it to a zombie, connecting to existing combat nodes.
读取植物转对象的位置，作为装饰对象的生成位置。: Reads the position of the plant-to-object, to use as the spawn position of the decorative object.
将路标移动到鼠标位置，大小倍率0.5。: Moves the waypoint to the mouse position, scale multiplier 0.5.
仅修改事件图创建的装饰对象。植物/僵尸请用专用移动节点，避免只改Transfor: Only modifies decorative objects created by the event graph. For plants/zombies use the dedicated move node, to avoid wrong tile occupancy or row index from changing only the Transform.
只允许删除事件图拥有的对象；植物、僵尸、卡牌等实体使用对应节点，避免绕过游戏清理: Only objects owned by the event graph may be deleted; for plants, zombies, cards and other entities use the matching nodes, to avoid bypassing the game's cleanup flow.
Bullet_pea是普通豌豆，同一种子弹可以由两种阵营发射。: Bullet_pea is the normal pea; the same bullet type can be fired by both factions.
未加载资源的类型会在发射时失败。移动方式统一采用指定角度的自由直线飞行。: Types whose resources are not loaded fail when fired. Movement is always free straight-line flight at the given angle.
行2、列3.5、伤害20、速度6、角度0、大小1；角度180向左。: Row 2, column 3.5, damage 20, speed 6, angle 0, size 1; angle 180 goes left.
行列从0开始。角度0右、90上、180左、270下。采用游戏对象池和碰撞效果；出: Rows and columns start from 0. Angle 0 is right, 90 up, 180 left, 270 down. Uses the game's object pool and collision effects; bullets that leave the map or exceed 20 seconds are still recycled by game rules.
选择方向角度、数值90，将子弹转向上方。: Pick Direction Angle with value 90 to turn the bullet upward.
子弹已回收后走失败，池复用同一GameObject也不会误改新子弹。大小以这枚子: If the bullet has already been recycled it takes Failed, and a pool reusing the same GameObject will not change a new bullet by mistake. Size is based on this bullet's original size, and repeated settings do not multiply.
Day地图的阶段事件接此节点，选择Night，切换到夜晚。: Connect the Day map's stage event to this node and pick Night to switch to night.
支持Day/Night、Day_6/Night_6、Pool/NightPool: Supports swapping within each group: Day/Night, Day_6/Night_6, Pool/NightPool, Roof/NightRoof, the three Odyssey roof periods, the three roof-pool periods, and SnowPool day/night. Different groups or special maps output Failed and the battlefield stays unchanged. At least 1 second apart; does not change sun, tiles, entities, waves or game speed.
每次循环接施加僵尸状态，当前僵尸接目标。: Connect Apply Zombie Status to Each Loop and the current zombie to the target.
触发时生成一次快照，循环中新增的僵尸下次才纳入；循环期间死亡的僵尸跳过。包括魅惑: A snapshot is taken when triggered; zombies added during the loop are only included next time, and zombies that die during the loop are skipped. Includes charmed zombies; filter as needed.
输入0.5秒，让该植物每次攻击的基础等待时间变为0.5秒。: Enter 0.5 seconds to make the plant's base wait time per attack 0.5 seconds.
范围0.05～3600秒；攻速增益仍按游戏原公式叠加。只对使用基础攻击间隔的植物: Range 0.05-3600 seconds; attack speed bonuses still stack by the game's original formula. Only affects plants that use a base attack interval; does not reset the current attack animation or special skill timers.
触发接本节点、植物接目标，自动尝试喂豆；已生效口判断实际是否投喂成功。: Connect the trigger to this node and the plant to the target to automatically try feeding a bean; the Applied port checks whether feeding actually succeeded.
无需玩家拿起豆子；仍遵守金币、可升级类型和大招条件，并扣除原有费用。完成代表完成: No need for the player to pick up a bean; still follows coin, upgradable-type and ultimate conditions, and deducts the original cost. 索引从0开始，最多512项。元素类型必须与操作节点一致；复制列表复制值，不共享容: Indices start from 0, up to 512 items. The element type must match the operation node; copying a list copies values and does not share the container. For object initial values, enter the object binding name.
